# Event Requirements Checklist: Event-Driven Catalog Updates

**Purpose**: Validate whether event-driven catalog update requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and review-ready before implementation and PR approval.
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: `specs/010-catalog-event-updates/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements explicitly defined for processing all three change types (create, update, delete) within provider ownership scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the exact notification payload contract, including required fields and handling of missing fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are retry, dead-letter, and continued-processing expectations fully specified for unprocessable notifications? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are auditable outcome requirements complete for both success and failure paths, including DLQ disposition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is “latest known values” unambiguous about whether freshness is based on queue delivery order, source timestamps, or another ordering signal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is “bounded number of retries” quantified with a specific retry limit and retry timing policy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “authorized principals” defined with concrete principal classes and boundary conditions for publish vs consume access? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “existing Backstage removal behavior” referenced precisely enough to avoid interpretation drift? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Ambiguity]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do ordering requirements for FIFO snapshot application align with fallback polling behavior without conflicting precedence rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Do idempotency requirements align across duplicate notification handling and update-not-found recovery behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are out-of-scope boundaries consistent between provider-only scope and external notification production dependency? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are the 60-second freshness criteria measurable from a clearly defined start point and observation point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is “processed successfully without manual operator intervention” defined with objective inclusion/exclusion rules? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the polling reduction baseline and measurement window explicitly defined to make the 80% target reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are sampled-trial rules for downstream setup timing defined (sample size, environment, and pass criteria)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirement statements complete for primary flows (create, update, delete) and their expected catalog outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Are alternate flow requirements defined for duplicate deliveries and update events referencing unknown entities? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are exception flow requirements defined for malformed notifications and unsupported change types? [Coverage, Edge Cases, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are recovery flow requirements explicit for event-channel disruption and fallback synchronization restoration? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, User Story 3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements explicit about behavior when fallback polling updates state before delayed FIFO event delivery? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements explicit for repeat notifications after prior successful processing, including expected no-regression semantics? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for partial processing failures where one message fails but subsequent messages must continue? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are least-privilege access control requirements specific enough to be auditable against publish and consume pathways? [Non-Functional, Security, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK024 Are observability requirements sufficient to support operational diagnosis within stated success targets? [Non-Functional, Operability, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are external dependency expectations for upstream event publication completeness explicitly validated or bounded? [Dependency, Assumptions, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK026 Are assumptions about fallback polling interval and unchanged lifecycle rules translated into explicit requirement constraints where needed? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Is there any unresolved conflict between “latest known values” wording and strict FIFO application when snapshots are stale relative to polled state? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK028 Is there an explicit requirement for requirement-ID traceability across functional requirements and success criteria to support auditability? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
